CQC signal intelligence

Decide which care organisations are worth approaching next, and why

CareGist sells two products. The Weekly Digest follows one England region week by week; the Territory Opportunity Brief ranks the accounts worth approaching there. Both are built on observation-dated evidence from CQC's published record. The pilot costs £150 for four weekly digests. The Brief costs £745. Both are one-off purchases, with no subscription or automatic renewal.

How to order

For a Territory Opportunity Brief, choose your region, review matching organisations, then email your scope for review. For the Weekly Digest, email the England region you want covered and a start date. Online ordering is not available. Neither route places an order or takes payment by itself.

Weekly Digest

£150 one-off pilot

Watch one England region week by week: new CQC registrations, rating changes, and closures, each with the published record behind it.

£150

One-off pilot · four weekly digests · no automatic renewal

Included

  • ✓Four consecutive weekly digests covering one England region you choose
  • ✓New registrations, rating changes, and closures where the published CQC record supports them
  • ✓A direct official-source link on every item
  • ✓Report and observation dates carried through each digest

Scope and availability

One England region per four-week pack. Email to confirm your region, your buyer type, and a start date. Online ordering is not available.

Keep the week's movement in view without buying another provider directory.

Enquire about the £150 pilot

No email app? Email outreach@caregist.co.uk from your webmail with your England region, provider group and preferred start date. We confirm availability before any payment.

Territory Opportunity Brief

One-off brief

Should your sales team prioritise Birmingham and Solihull, or put its next quarter elsewhere?

£745

One-off · no subscription · check territory coverage

Included

  • ✓CRM-import-ready territory dataset
  • ✓Ranked shortlist of 25–50 priority organisations, each with a stated reason
  • ✓3–5 page brief on territory size, market structure, notable movements, and recommended approach
  • ✓Observation dates carried through the deliverable

Scope and availability

Check matching organisations online, then email your scope. We confirm suitability, availability and delivery before any payment.

Choose the accounts worth approaching next and see the evidence behind each priority.

Check your territory

Free Directory

Free · no account required

Provider discovery and official-source checking

£0

Included

  • ✓Search CQC-registered providers
  • ✓Browse profiles, ratings, source dates, and official links
  • ✓Report factual record issues to CareGist support

Scope and availability

No Radar workspace, event history, API, or webhooks.

Open the directory

What we do not sell

CareGist does not compete on record count or sell paid listing rank, speculative vacancy claims, predictive scores, or unsupported movement claims. The launch products explain which accounts or market changes deserve review and show the observation-dated evidence behind them.

CareGist is not currently VAT registered, so VAT is not currently charged.

CQC information is reused under the Open Government Licence v3.0. CareGist is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Care Quality Commission.

CareGist Territory intelligence
One-off Territory Opportunity Brief

Know which care organisations to research first.

A territory-specific account review for UK care-sector suppliers and advisers. Get a shortlist built against your agreed criteria, with the source facts and limits visible throughout.

Territory Opportunity Brief
£745

£745 fixed fee. No VAT added.

Check your territory

Online ordering is not available. Check coverage and email your scope for review. No payment is taken on this page, and a coverage count does not confirm pack availability or delivery.

What you receive

A clear account-research starting point

The Brief is designed for a defined territory and question. It gives your team a reusable account list and a transparent reason to review each selected organisation.

01

Territory dataset

An editable CSV dataset of qualifying care locations in the agreed scope, with provider grouping and source fields.

02

25–50 organisations

A shortlist selected against your agreed criteria. Every entry carries a published fact, reason for inclusion, qualification question and stated uncertainty.

03

Executive brief

A three to five page summary of the territory, priorities, evidence and limits so your team can decide what to check next.

04

Traceable evidence

Source edition dates, location and provider identifiers, and links to published CQC evidence where retained in the delivery pack.

Check coverage first

See how many organisations match your scope

Pick a region and provider group below. We check the published CQC record for that exact scope before you email us — this is free, and it does not place an order.

Choose your territory

Pick a region and the organisations you sell to. We check the published CQC record for matching organisations. This check is free and does not place an order.

How it works

Agree the question, then build the Brief

STEP 1

Check coverage

Use the tool above to see how many organisations match your region and provider group, then email us your scope.

STEP 2

Source and delivery check

CareGist confirms that the available public source supports the scope, then agrees the actual delivery date.

STEP 3

Delivery

The documented target is three working days after scope and source checks. The confirmed date is recorded before work starts.

STEP 4

Use the shortlist

Review the evidence, map the fields to your CRM and qualify accounts through your own sales or advisory process.

What it is

A dated, evidence-led account-research pack. It helps organise published care-sector information around your question.

What it is not

It does not establish vacancies, budgets, buying intent, current compliance, ownership, director links or a guaranteed commercial outcome.

CareGist is independent of the Care Quality Commission and does not represent or endorse it. CQC information is reused under the Open Government Licence v3.0. CareGist is independent and is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Care Quality Commission.

Prefer to talk it through first? See all products or email outreach@caregist.co.uk.

One-off research product

Know which care organisations to research first.

Instead of handing your team a directory to filter, CareGist supplies a buyer-specific starting list, the factual reason for each organisation and the source trail behind it.

Territory Opportunity Brief

£745

£745 fixed fee. No VAT added.

Check your territory

We confirm your territory, buyer criteria and source readiness before accepting payment.

Who it is for

Teams selling into, advising or investing in UK care.

It is designed for compliance advisers, recruitment and staffing firms, software, insurance and other suppliers. It gives your team a defined list to research, rather than a broad directory to work through.

The work you avoid

More useful than a list of organisations.

The public directory is available to everyone. The brief gives your team a defined research starting point and records how the selection was made.

Your team would otherwise need to

The brief provides

Find the relevant organisations

A buyer-specific 25 to 50 organisation shortlist for the agreed territory.

Decide why each one belongs

A stated factual reason for each organisation against the agreed criteria.

Prepare a usable working file

A CRM-ready CSV dataset.

Trace information back to source

Public CQC source links and observation dates carried into the pack.

Brief the wider team

A three to five page executive brief.

What you receive

01

A buyer-specific shortlist of 25 to 50 care organisations in an agreed England territory.

02

A CRM-ready CSV dataset covering the agreed shortlist and the fields available from the checked public sources.

03

A three to five page executive brief explaining the agreed selection criteria and the factual reasons each organisation was included.

04

Source links and observation dates for the public CQC information used in the brief.

Delivery

A clear scope before a useful shortlist.

  1. 1. Agree the brief. You confirm the territory, buyer type and the criteria your team will use.
  2. 2. Confirm the source check. We confirm the relevant public-source path is available for the agreed scope.
  3. 3. Receive the pack. The delivery target is three working days after both checks are complete.

Free dated format example

A Birmingham and Solihull format example shows the structure of a buyer-specific brief without publishing its shortlist or delivery files.

This example is not for sale. It shows the format and evidence structure only. Its dated source material is not a claim about live conditions in another territory.

View the free Birmingham and Solihull example

What the brief does not say

  • This is research support for organisations that sell to, advise or invest in UK care. It is not a list of providers to contact for care.
  • The brief does not claim buying intent, vacancies, budget, contract timing or a commercial outcome.
  • CareGist is independent of CQC. Customers should check the linked official sources before making a regulated, clinical, employment, credit or other high-impact decision.

Business Terms of Service

Version 2.1 · In force from 9 September 2026

These terms govern use of CareGist by a business, public body, charity, or professional customer. H-Kay Limited provides the CareGist product, registered in England and Wales under company number 10417923, with registered office at C/O Bilberry Accountants Ltd, Castle Court, 41 London Road, Reigate, England, RH2 9RJ ("H-Kay Limited", "we", "us"). If you accept these terms for an organisation, you confirm that you are authorised to bind it.

The paid services are not offered for personal, family, or household use. A person seeking care should use the free directory and verify information directly with CQC and the provider.

1. Products and scope

  • Free Directory: provider search, profiles, source dates, and free correction or claim requests when verification intake is available.
  • Territory Opportunity Brief: a one-off, buyer-specific research pack for an agreed England territory. It includes a shortlist of 25 to 50 organisations, a CRM-ready CSV dataset, a three to five page executive brief, and source links and observation dates for the public CQC information used.
  • Radar Regional: one contracted England region, 2 users, 10 saved views, and 90 days of event export.
  • Radar National: all England, 5 users, 50 saved views or lists, 365 days of event export, and onboarding.
  • Intelligence Feed Pilot: a sales-assisted, contracted API and webhook pilot with a stated region, signal, and delivery scope.
  • Embedded Enterprise: a separately contracted white-label or regulated-use service.

Radar does not include API or webhook access. Additional seats are not sold separately at launch. A written order form, pilot statement, or enterprise agreement prevails over these terms for its expressly stated scope.

For a Territory Opportunity Brief, the written scope confirmation identifies the territory, buyer criteria and factual selection criteria. It is the order form for that purchase and prevails where it differs from a general statement on this site.

2. Source data and evidence

CareGist reuses CQC public information under the Open Government Licence v3.0. CareGist is independent of and is not endorsed by CQC. Source systems may delay, correct, remove, or republish information. CareGist records when it checked and observed a source; those timestamps are not a statement that the underlying change occurred at that time.

A location-level signal must not be treated as a provider-group conclusion. Customers must check the linked official evidence before making a regulated, clinical, safeguarding, employment, credit, or other high-impact decision.

3. Explanations and ranking

CareGist may attach a plain-language explanation to a verified event only after its factual claims pass the applicable evidence gate. If generation, extraction, or evaluation fails, the verified raw event may be delivered without a narrative. Source facts and CareGist interpretation are labelled separately.

Initial ranking uses explainable factors such as recency, contracted territory, service type, explicit provider lists, and the organisation's recorded actions. CareGist does not sell predictive scores, vacancy claims, or guaranteed commercial opportunities.

4. Accounts and organisations

  • Users must be at least 18 and provide accurate account information.
  • Each organisation controls its members, saved views, provider lists, actions, outcomes, subscriptions, and deliveries.
  • Credentials must not be shared outside the named organisation users.
  • Owners and admins are responsible for member access and territory configuration.
  • Customers must promptly report suspected unauthorised access.

5. Customer data and outcomes

Customers may save provider lists, actions, and optional outcomes such as contacted, meeting booked, engagement won, or not relevant. The customer is responsible for having a lawful basis for personal data it submits and must not upload special-category data, patient data, care records, or other data that the product does not request.

CareGist does not place customer data into report-narrative prompts. Any enterprise processing terms or customer-owned list integration must be agreed in the applicable contract or data-processing agreement.

6. Fees, subscription and cancellation

Current prices and included limits are shown on the pricing page or in the signed order form. No VAT is added. Stripe processes self-serve payments; H-Kay Limited does not store full card details.

Radar subscriptions renew for the displayed billing period until cancelled. Cancellation takes effect at the end of the current paid period unless law or an agreed order form requires otherwise. Customers can use billing management or contact support. Feed and Embedded terms, renewal, service levels, and termination are set out in the signed agreement.

The Territory Opportunity Brief costs £745. CareGist confirms the scope and the relevant source path before it sends a payment link or accepts payment. Payment is due in full before work begins. The buyer may cancel by email before work begins and receive a full refund. Once work has begun on the agreed bespoke brief, the fee is non-refundable except where CareGist fails to deliver the agreed scope or a remedy cannot lawfully be excluded. If a source issue after payment prevents delivery of the agreed scope, CareGist will offer a revised delivery date or a full refund if the parties do not agree an alternative scope.

7. Availability and delivery targets

Public statements labelled as a target are not a guaranteed service level. Any contracted service level applies only when written into the relevant Feed or Embedded agreement. Upstream CQC unavailability, delay, correction, and schema change can affect collection and delivery.

The delivery target for a Territory Opportunity Brief is three working days after both the written scope confirmation and source-path check are complete. A working day is Monday to Friday, excluding public holidays in England. The target is not a guaranteed service level. If a material source issue affects the agreed scope, CareGist will notify the buyer and apply the remedy in section 6.

CareGist may pause a collector, signal type, explanation, outbound delivery, or checkout to protect accuracy, security, or tenant isolation.

8. Acceptable use

Customers must not:

  • use the service unlawfully or to send unlawful unsolicited communications;
  • attempt to access another organisation's data or bypass plan scope;
  • misrepresent CareGist output as official CQC advice or a guaranteed prediction;
  • use a signal as the sole basis for a high-impact decision about a person;
  • interfere with, reverse engineer, or overload the service.

The Acceptable Use Policy also applies.

9. Intellectual property and licence

CQC data remains subject to its source rights and the Open Government Licence. CareGist owns or licenses its original software, event modelling, explanations, interface, and branding. During a paid term, the customer may use included outputs for its internal business purpose. White-label, redistribution, sublicensing, or embedding requires a written agreement.

Exports must retain the supplied CQC/Open Government Licence attribution and CareGist source metadata.

10. Disclaimers and liability

CQC information and third-party links are provided as published and may be incomplete, delayed, or corrected. CareGist does not guarantee a rating change, closure, expansion, engagement, or other commercial result.

To the fullest extent permitted by law, neither party is liable for indirect or consequential loss. CareGist's aggregate liability under self-serve Radar is limited to fees paid for that service in the preceding 12 months. For a Territory Opportunity Brief, it is limited to the fee paid for that brief. A signed enterprise agreement may set a different cap. Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be limited, including fraud or death or personal injury caused by negligence.

11. Suspension, termination and changes

CareGist may suspend access where reasonably necessary for security, non-payment, unlawful use, tenant protection, or material breach. Where practical, notice and an opportunity to remedy will be given. Material terms changes will be notified to registered customers and will not retrospectively alter a completed purchase.

12. Governing law and contact

These terms are governed by the laws of England and Wales and the courts of England and Wales have exclusive jurisdiction, subject to any mandatory law. Questions may be sent to legal@caregist.co.uk or by post to H-Kay Limited at the registered office stated above.
